note: Every string is an exact substring of the named copied raw file (report text or a wall-clock.jsonl reaction field). Nothing paraphrased, no quote substitution, no word replacement, no pipes, no newlines. primaryReturn is the opening return answer in report.md. laterFullReturn is the separate section 7 answer. rankedAsks are the top three asks of report.md. laterAskSpans are the section 8 wording, kept only where it adds or changes content, labelled separately. Miles wrapped his opening answer in producer quote marks, which are not part of the span. Internal double quotes are original.

emre.primaryReturn: I would come back another evening on desktop to try a third path, for example paying the bill myself and telling Selin everything, but only because each run is short, and not tonight. I would not leave it running. It does not run in real time, so there is nothing to leave running.
emre.laterFullReturn: Yes, another evening on desktop for a third path, on the condition that the choices are different enough to be worth a second look. Because it is short, I would not leave it running; it does not seem to need me to.
rankedAsks: Show a number for savings. After I paid from savings the text said only "Her savings are smaller" on the phone run. I could not price that tradeoff.

Say why I could not see a choice or its cost in advance when it changed. On the phone run the visit cost 3 hours instead of 2 because Selin refused cover. I worked it out from the card text, but a one-line reason on the changed card would help.
Let me see the choice cards on the phone without scrolling past the story. I did not test the phone's scroll fully, and this ask rests on the screenshot alone.

laterAskSpans.2: Put a one-line reason on any card whose cost has changed from a first visit.
laterAskSpans.3: On the phone, keep the choice cards on screen with the story text.

pavel.primaryReturn: Not tonight. I might come back another evening on the desktop, to see whether the visit to Şükrü can be kept when I spend my hours differently, but I would not leave it running. Each run took about a minute and a half, and I want a reason to play it a third time.
pavel.laterFullReturn: Not tonight. I might come back another evening on the desktop, to see whether the visit to Şükrü can be kept when I spend my hours differently. I would not leave it running, because nothing in it runs by itself.
rankedAsks: Grey out or explain a choice I cannot afford before I press it. On desktop I pressed "Make the journey yourself, if there is time". It took one tap, said "2 hours; 1 remains", and moved the story on. I could not retry, and the game ended with my promised visit unkept and an hour unused.
Tell me the hour budget early. The visit needs 2 hours, but nothing warned me on day 1 or 2 that I must keep them. On the phone I kept the visit only because I happened to have 2 hours.
Give me something to read over time. Each run was about 75 seconds of choices with no clock, so it felt short and I could not compare one day with the next.

tessa.primaryReturn: Not tonight. I might come back another evening on my laptop only if the three days had more than two choices per screen, or a way to say something of my own, and I would not leave it running.
tessa.laterFullReturn: No, not tonight. I would come back another evening on my laptop only if there were more than two choices per screen, or a way to say something of my own. I did like seeing my choices named in the ending, and I might try a third run for a different ending. I would not leave it running, because it has no clock and just waits for a tap. I would not come back for the same three days I have now seen twice.
rankedAsks: Give me more than two buttons per moment, or let me say something of my own to Hacer, Burak or Selin. I only ever picked between two set lines.
Make the run longer or add a reason to play it again. Both of my runs finished in about 75 seconds.
Show the phone room picture and its objects properly. On the phone I read only the text and never saw the picture's objects.

laterAskSpans.2: Make a run longer, or give me a reason to replay beyond swapping which of two buttons I press.
laterAskSpans.3: Show the room picture and its objects properly on the phone, as the laptop does.

nia.primaryReturn: Not tonight, and I would not leave it running. I might come back another evening, but only if a second run gave me something new. Both of my runs took about 30 seconds each and ended the same way, so the whole game felt used up.
nia.laterFullReturn: Not tonight. I might come back another evening, but only if the game gave me a different story or a character who answered back. I would not leave it running, because there is nothing to wait for.
rankedAsks: Make the game longer or make later runs differ. I finished all three days in about 27 s on my phone and about 25 s on desktop. After that I only had "Play another three days".
Give me a reply from the people I'm affecting. After I read the private page aloud, or told Selin about my marriage, I got narration but no answer from the person I affected.
Tell me up front how much is at stake. The story texts said grief was not settled but never said what I had won or lost. I had to guess whether my choices mattered.

laterAskSpans.1: Make the game longer, or make a second run open on different scenes.
laterAskSpans.2: Let the people I affect answer me in their own words.
laterAskSpans.3: Say what is at stake before I choose, so I know my choices matter.

miles.primaryReturn: I would come back another evening for one more leave, to try the paid delivery and see if the hours can fit everything. I would come back only once, and only if the visit button stops letting me spend a turn I cannot afford.
miles.laterFullReturn: I would come back another evening for one more leave, to try the paid delivery and see if the hours can fit everything. I would come back only once, and only if the visit button stops letting me spend a turn I cannot afford. The story is gentle and honest, and I liked doing the sums. But each run takes under a minute, and after two runs I can already see most of the shape.
rankedAsks: Do not offer "Make the journey yourself" when the hours left are fewer than the visit needs. On the phone it took my last turn, and the delivery choice was gone afterwards.
Introduce Selin before she appears. On the desktop she "has the receipt" before anyone says who she is.
Make the tiredness and hour wording match what happens. "Saves an hour" left my hours unchanged. "Obtain the original" appeared after I already had the receipt in hand.

laterAskSpans.1: Hide or disable a visit I cannot afford, or keep the delivery choice open after a failed attempt.

laterExtraReturnSpans.Leave-it-running answer: No, there is nothing to leave running. It is something I would come back to another evening, briefly.
